verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video-generation product, since vendors in this category can ship downloadable weights or on-prem deployments. Every item in the pack describes a vendor-hosted service: a hosted API at api.lumalabs.ai, keys from platform.lumalabs.ai, credit-based pay-as-you-go billing, and dedicated capacity tiers. Nothing documents self-hostable software, model weights, or on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
